name: production-brief
title: Draft production brief
for_each: select id,code from productions order by code

sections.title: Programme and rights evidence
sections.sql: select position,title,credit,decision,authority,evidence from repertoire where production_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Calls (UTC)
sections.sql: select code,kind,space,starts_at,ends_at,status from call_sheet where production_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select code,description,owner,due,status,evidence from actions where production_id=$1 order by due

name: programme-sheet
title: Draft programme credits
for_each: select id,code from productions order by code

sections.title: Credits for human review
sections.sql: select position,title,creator,credit,duration_seconds from repertoire where production_id=$1 order by position

name: safety-handover
title: Draft safety and consultation evidence
for_each: select id,code from productions order by code

sections.title: Calls (UTC)
sections.sql: select code,kind,space,starts_at,planned_people,capacity,revision,safety_reviewed from call_sheet where production_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Recorded reviews, including superseded versions
sections.sql: select s.code,r.session_revision,r.evidence,r.consulted_with,r.actor,r.created_at from safety_reviews r join sessions s on s.id=r.session_id where s.production_id=$1 order by r.created_at
